1 Maximum Sum Sub-array Problem
This algorithm finds a sub-array with maximum sum in an array A which starts from low and ends at high in cubic
time.
Algorithm 1 Find-Maximum-Subarray-Cubic(A, low, high)
1: maxSum ← −∞ . Initialize maximum sum
2: startIndex ← low . Start index of the sub-array
3: endIndex ← low . End index of the sub-array
4: for i ← low to high do . Fix the start index of the sub-array to i
5: for j ← i to high do . Fix the end index of the sub-array to j
6: sum ← Find-Sum(A, i, j) . Find the sum of the sub-array using Algorithm 2
7: if sum > maxSum then . Sum of the sub-array is greater than the current maximum sum
8: maxSum ← sum . Update maximum sum
9: startIndex ← i . Update start index of the sub-array
10: endIndex ← j . Update end index of the sub-array
11: end if
12: end for
13: end for
14: return (maxSum, startIndex, endIndex)
This algorithm computes the sum of a sub-array which starts from low and ends at high in an array A.
Algorithm 2 Find-Sum(A, low, high)
1: sum ← 0
2: for i ← low to high do
3: sum ← sum + A[i]
4: end for
5: return sum
This algorithm finds a sub-array with maximum sum in an array A which starts from low and ends at high in
quadratic time.
Algorithm 3 Find-Maximum-Subarray-Quadratic(A, low, high)
1: maxSum ← −∞ . Initialize maximum sum
2: startIndex ← low . Start index of the sub-array
3: endIndex ← low . End index of the sub-array
4: for i ← low to high do . Fix the start index of the sub-array to i
5: sum ← 0 . Initialize the sum of the sub-array starting from index i to 0
6: for j ← i to high do . Fix the end index of the sub-array to j
7: sum ← sum + A[j] . Find the sum of the sub-array starting from index i and ending at index j
8: if sum > maxSum then . Sum of the sub-array is greater than the current maximum sum
9: maxSum ← sum . Update maximum sum
10: startIndex ← i . Update start index of the sub-array
11: endIndex ← j . Update end index of the sub-array
12: end if
13: end for
14: end for
15: return (maxSum, startIndex, endIndex)

Algorithm 4 Find-Maximum-Subarray-Linear-Logarithm(A, low, high)

2: return hlow, high, A[low]i

4: mid ← b(low+high)/2c

6: hright-low, right-high, right-sumi ← Find-Maximum-Subarray-Linear-Logarithm(A, mid +
1, high)
7: hcross-low, cross-high, cross-sumi ← Find-Maximum-Crossing-Subarray(A, low, mid, high)
8: if left-sum ≥ right-sum && left-sum ≥ cross-sum then
9: return hleft-low, left-high, left-sumi
10: else if right-sum ≥ left-sum && right-sum ≥ cross-sum then
11: return hright-low, right-high, right-sumi
12: else
13: return hcross-low, cross-high, cross-sumi
14: end if
15: end if
Algorithm 5 Find-Maximum-Crossing-Subarray(A, low, mid, high)
1: left-sum ← −∞
2: sum ← 0
3: for i ← mid downto low do
4: sum ← sum + A[i]
5: if sum > left-sum then
6: left-sum ← sum
7: max-left ← i
8: end if
9: end for
10: right-sum ← −∞
11: sum ← 0
12: for i ← mid + 1 downto high do
13: sum ← sum + A[i]
14: if sum > right-sum then
15: right-sum ← sum
16: max-right ← i
17: end if
18: end for
19: return hmax-left, max-right, left-sum + right-sumi
